privacy Log out Off Accessibility Mode Seven new world-class models at scalable price-performance Nov 17, 2026 &middot; Announcements &middot; Ignite Back to news Share Share this article &times; LinkedIn (opens in a new tab) X (opens in a new tab) Facebook (opens in a new tab) Article link Copy link Share At MAI, our mission is to build you the very best models in the world and keep every developer and every enterprise at the frontier of capability. But as token spend skyrockets, we know that you also want models at a price point that lets you run agents 24/7 doing real engineering work. That’s why today we’re releasing a family of seven new world class models at a truly exceptional price-performance. Here’s the lineup: MAI Cyber 2 Flash beats GPT-6 Astra’s quality at less than 2% of the cost per task on the CyberGym-E2E benchmark. MAI Code 2 reaches 98% of the coding quality of GPT-6.1 Sol at about 40% of the price. And against Opus 5.5, it reaches 96% performance for just 5% of the price. MAI Code 2 Flash shows comparable performance GPT-6 Luna at 65% of the price, and Haiku 5.5 at 20% of the price. MAI Image 2.7 is #1 on Artificial Analysis image editing, outperforming GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst (max) at just one-fifth of the price. MAI Realtime 1 outperforms GPT-Realtime 2.1 and starts at just $0.01 per audio minute. Dragon Copilot Transcribe is built on MAI Transcribe 2, the world&#8217;s fastest and most accurate multilingual transcription model, and already powers 10 million patient encounters a month with multilingual error rates halved. Decision 1.1 is the latest decision model from Microsoft, 50x faster and 79x cheaper than GPT-6.1 Sol. Maia 200 , Microsoft’s second-generation AI accelerator, is now in production running our largest models, achieving 1.7x more tokens per watt.
